+def build_case(table, field_names, ambiguous_primary_key_field=None):
+    fields = {}
+    for name in field_names:
+        is_ambiguous_pk = name == ambiguous_primary_key_field
+        fields[name] = SimpleNamespace(
+            column=name,
+            primary_key=is_ambiguous_pk,
+            unique=is_ambiguous_pk,
+        )
+
+    meta = SimpleNamespace(
+        db_table=table,
+        fields=list(fields.values()),
+        unique_together=(
+            ((ambiguous_primary_key_field,),)
+            if ambiguous_primary_key_field is not None
+            else (tuple(field_names),)
+        ),
+        constraints=[],
+        indexes=[],
+    )
+    meta.get_field = lambda name: fields[name]
+    model = SimpleNamespace(_meta=meta)
+
+    unique_name = "%s_%s_uniq" % (table, "_".join(field_names))
+    primary_key_name = "%s_pkey" % table
+    executed = []
+
+    editor = object.__new__(BaseDatabaseSchemaEditor)
+    editor.connection = SimpleNamespace(
+        features=SimpleNamespace(allows_multiple_constraints_on_same_fields=True)
+    )
+
+    def constraint_names(model_arg, columns, exclude=None, **kwargs):
+        if (
+            ambiguous_primary_key_field is not None
+            and columns == [ambiguous_primary_key_field]
+            and kwargs.get("unique") is True
+        ):
+            if kwargs.get("primary_key") is False:
+                return [unique_name]
+            return [primary_key_name, unique_name]
+        return [unique_name]
+
+    editor._constraint_names = constraint_names
+    editor._delete_constraint_sql = lambda sql, model_arg, name: "%s %s" % (sql, name)
+    editor.execute = lambda statement: executed.append(statement)
+    editor._unique_constraint_name = lambda table_arg, columns, quote=True: unique_name
+    editor._create_index_name = lambda table_arg, columns, suffix="": unique_name
+
+    return model, editor, executed, unique_name
+
+

+    max_examples=200,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[

+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):

+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")

+            first = data.draw(st.sampled_from(["year", "slug", "code"]), label="first")
+            second = data.draw(
+                st.sampled_from([name for name in ["year", "slug", "code"] if name != first]),
+                label="second",
+            )
+
+            model, editor, executed, unique_name = build_case(table, [first, second])
+            editor._delete_composed_index(
+                model,
+                [first, second],
+                {"unique": True},
+                "DROP UNIQUE",
+            )
+
+            assert executed == ["DROP UNIQUE %s" % unique_name]
+
+        elif is_regression == "false":
+            pk_field = data.draw(
+                st.sampled_from(["id", "pk", "identifier"]),
+                label="pk_field",
+            )
+
+            model, editor, executed, unique_name = build_case(
+                table,
+                [pk_field],
+                ambiguous_primary_key_field=pk_field,
+            )
+            editor._delete_composed_index(
+                model,
+                [pk_field],
+                {"unique": True},
+                "DROP UNIQUE",
+            )
+
+            assert executed == ["DROP UNIQUE %s" % unique_name]
+
+        else:

+    return models.CharField(**kwargs)

+

+import sys
+import types
+from hypothesis import given
+from hypothesis import strategies as st
+from hypothesis import settings as hypothesis_settings
+from hypothesis import HealthCheck
+
+_CURRENT_USER = None
+_BACKEND_MODULE = "pbt_secret_key_fallback_auth_backend"
+_BACKEND_PATH = _BACKEND_MODULE + ".MemoryBackend"
+
+
+class MemoryBackend:
+    def authenticate(self, request, **credentials):
+        return None
+
+    def get_user(self, user_id):
+        if _CURRENT_USER is not None and str(_CURRENT_USER.pk) == str(user_id):
+            return _CURRENT_USER
+        return None
+
+
+class SessionMapping(dict):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.flushed = False
+        self.cycled = False
+
+    def flush(self):
+        self.flushed = True
+        self.clear()
+
+    def cycle_key(self):
+        self.cycled = True
+
+
+# Helper functions (ONLY for test setup/teardown and data construction —
+# NOT for reimplementing library logic):
+def setup_state():
+    from django.conf import settings
+
+    if not settings.configured:
+        settings.configure(
+            SECRET_KEY="initial-secret",
+            SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS=[],
+            INSTALLED_APPS=[
+                "django.contrib.auth",
+                "django.contrib.contenttypes",
+            ],
+            DATABASES={
+                "default": {
+                    "ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3",
+                    "NAME": ":memory:",
+                }
+            },
+            AUTHENTICATION_BACKENDS=[_BACKEND_PATH],
+            USE_TZ=True,
+            DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
+        )
+
+    import django
+    from django.apps import apps
+
+    if not apps.ready:
+        django.setup()
+
+    module = types.ModuleType(_BACKEND_MODULE)
+    module.MemoryBackend = MemoryBackend
+    sys.modules[_BACKEND_MODULE] = module
+    return {"override": None}
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    global _CURRENT_USER
+    override = state.get("override")
+    if override is not None:
+        override.disable()
+    _CURRENT_USER = None
+    sys.modules.pop(_BACKEND_MODULE, None)
+
+
+# Property-based test:
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(max_examples=200, deadline=None, suppress_health_check=[HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture, HealthCheck.too_slow, HealthCheck.filter_too_much])
+def test(data):
+    import os
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    # --- Setup ---
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        from types import SimpleNamespace
+        from django.contrib.auth import BACKEND_SESSION_KEY, HASH_SESSION_KEY, SESSION_KEY, get_user
+        from django.contrib.auth.models import User
+        from django.test import override_settings
+
+        alphabet = st.characters(min_codepoint=33, max_codepoint=126)
+        secrets = data.draw(
+            st.lists(st.text(alphabet=alphabet, min_size=1, max_size=32), min_size=2, max_size=2, unique=True)
+        )
+        password = data.draw(st.text(alphabet=alphabet, min_size=0, max_size=64))
+        user_id = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=10**9))
+
+        global _CURRENT_USER
+        user = User(id=user_id, username="pbt-user", password=password)
+        _CURRENT_USER = user
+
+        session = SessionMapping()
+        session[SESSION_KEY] = str(user.pk)
+        session[BACKEND_SESSION_KEY] = _BACKEND_PATH
+        request = SimpleNamespace(session=session)
+
+        if is_regression == "true":
+            # Regression test logic:
+            # A session hash created with the current SECRET_KEY is already handled correctly.
+            current_secret, fallback_secret = secrets
+            context = override_settings(
+                SECRET_KEY=current_secret,
+                SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS=[fallback_secret],
+                AUTHENTICATION_BACKENDS=[_BACKEND_PATH],
+            )
+            context.enable()
+            state["override"] = context
+
+            session[HASH_SESSION_KEY] = user.get_session_auth_hash()
+            result = get_user(request)
+
+            assert result is user
+            assert not session.flushed
+        elif is_regression == "false":
+            # Reproduction test logic:
+            # A session hash created with the previous SECRET_KEY should remain valid when
+            # that key is listed in SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS after rotation.
+            new_secret, old_secret = secrets
+
+            old_context = override_settings(
+                SECRET_KEY=old_secret,
+                SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS=[],
+                AUTHENTICATION_BACKENDS=[_BACKEND_PATH],
+            )
+            old_context.enable()
+            try:
+                old_session_hash = user.get_session_auth_hash()
+            finally:
+                old_context.disable()
+
+            rotated_context = override_settings(
+                SECRET_KEY=new_secret,
+                SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS=[old_secret],
+                AUTHENTICATION_BACKENDS=[_BACKEND_PATH],
+            )
+            rotated_context.enable()
+            state["override"] = rotated_context
+
+            session[HASH_SESSION_KEY] = old_session_hash
+            result = get_user(request)
+
+            assert result is user
+            assert not session.flushed
+        else:
+            print("Error: IS_REGRESSION must be either 'true' or 'false'.")
+            sys.exit(1)
+    finally:
+        teardown_state(state)  # Always clean up, even on failure
+
+
+# Entry point:
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+    pytest.main([__file__, '--hypothesis-verbosity=verbose', '--hypothesis-log-all', '-vs'])

+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from hypothesis import HealthCheck
+from hypothesis import given
+from hypothesis import settings as hypothesis_settings
+from hypothesis import strategies as st
+
+try:
+    from sklearn.linear_model.logistic import LogisticRegression, _log_reg_scoring_path
+except ImportError:
+    from sklearn.linear_model._logistic import LogisticRegression, _log_reg_scoring_path
+
+try:
+    from sklearn.metrics.scorer import get_scorer
+except ImportError:
+    from sklearn.metrics import get_scorer
+
+
+def setup_state():
+    return None
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    pass
+
+
+def make_problem(rng, n_classes, n_features, n_train_per_class, n_eval_per_class):
+    centers = np.zeros((n_classes, n_features))
+    for k in range(n_classes):
+        centers[k, k % n_features] = 3.0
+    centers -= centers.mean(axis=0)
+    centers += rng.normal(scale=0.2, size=centers.shape)
+
+    train_blocks = []
+    eval_blocks = []
+    train_labels = []
+    eval_labels = []
+
+    for k in range(n_classes):
+        train_blocks.append(
+            rng.normal(
+                loc=centers[k],
+                scale=0.8,
+                size=(n_train_per_class, n_features),
+            )
+        )
+        train_labels.extend([k] * n_train_per_class)
+
+    for k in range(n_classes):
+        eval_blocks.append(
+            rng.normal(
+                loc=centers[k],
+                scale=0.8,
+                size=(n_eval_per_class, n_features),
+            )
+        )
+        eval_labels.extend([k] * n_eval_per_class)
+
+    X = np.vstack(train_blocks + eval_blocks)
+    y = np.asarray(train_labels + eval_labels)
+    n_train = len(train_labels)
+    train = np.arange(n_train)
+    eval_idx = np.arange(n_train, X.shape[0])
+    return X, y, train, eval_idx
+
+
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(
+    max_examples=30,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[
+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,
+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):
+    import os
+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        seed = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=2 ** 31 - 1))
+        n_features = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=3, max_value=6))
+        n_train_per_class = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=6, max_value=10))
+        n_eval_per_class = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=2, max_value=5))
+        C = data.draw(st.sampled_from([0.5, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0]))
+
+        rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
+        scorer = get_scorer("neg_log_loss")
+
+        if is_regression == "true":
+            X, y, train, eval_idx = make_problem(
+                rng,
+                n_classes=2,
+                n_features=n_features,
+                n_train_per_class=n_train_per_class,
+                n_eval_per_class=n_eval_per_class,
+            )
+
+            coefs, _, scores, _ = _log_reg_scoring_path(
+                X,
+                y,
+                train,
+                eval_idx,
+                Cs=[C],
+                scoring="neg_log_loss",
+                fit_intercept=True,
+                solver="lbfgs",
+                max_iter=300,
+                tol=1e-6,
+                multi_class="ovr",
+            )
+
+            w = np.asarray(coefs)[0]
+            log_reg = LogisticRegression(
+                fit_intercept=True,
+                solver="lbfgs",
+                multi_class="ovr",
+            )
+            log_reg.classes_ = np.unique(y[train])
+            log_reg.coef_ = w[np.newaxis, :-1]
+            log_reg.intercept_ = np.asarray([w[-1]])
+            log_reg.n_features_in_ = X.shape[1]
+
+            expected = scorer(log_reg, X[eval_idx], y[eval_idx])
+            np.testing.assert_allclose(
+                np.asarray(scores).ravel()[0],
+                expected,
+                rtol=1e-7,
+                atol=1e-7,
+            )
+
+        elif is_regression == "false":
+            X, y, train, eval_idx = make_problem(
+                rng,
+                n_classes=3,
+                n_features=n_features,
+                n_train_per_class=n_train_per_class,
+                n_eval_per_class=n_eval_per_class,
+            )
+
+            coefs, _, scores, _ = _log_reg_scoring_path(
+                X,
+                y,
+                train,
+                eval_idx,
+                Cs=[C],
+                scoring="neg_log_loss",
+                fit_intercept=True,
+                solver="lbfgs",
+                max_iter=300,
+                tol=1e-6,
+                multi_class="multinomial",
+            )
+
+            w = np.asarray(coefs)[0]
+            log_reg = LogisticRegression(
+                fit_intercept=True,
+                solver="lbfgs",
+                multi_class="multinomial",
+            )
+            log_reg.classes_ = np.unique(y[train])
+            log_reg.coef_ = w[:, :-1]
+            log_reg.intercept_ = w[:, -1]
+            log_reg.n_features_in_ = X.shape[1]
+
+            expected = scorer(log_reg, X[eval_idx], y[eval_idx])
+            np.testing.assert_allclose(
+                np.asarray(scores).ravel()[0],
+                expected,
+                rtol=1e-7,
+                atol=1e-7,
+            )
+        else:
+            print("Error: IS_REGRESSION must be either 'true' or 'false'.")
+            sys.exit(1)
+    finally:
+        teardown_state(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+
+    pytest.main([
+        __file__,
+        "--hypothesis-verbosity=verbose",
+        "--hypothesis-log-all",
+        "-vs",
+    ])

+)

+    import os
+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        names = data.draw(
+            st.lists(
+                st.text(
+                    alphabet="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_",
+                    min_size=1,
+                    max_size=6,
+                ).map(lambda value: "func_" + value),
+                min_size=1,
+                max_size=4,
+                unique=True,
+            )
+        )
+
+        if is_regression == "true":
+            exported = [data.draw(st.sampled_from(names))]
+        elif is_regression == "false":
+            exported = []
+        else:
+            print("Error: IS_REGRESSION must be either 'true' or 'false'.")
+            sys.exit(1)
+
+        module_name = state["module_name"]
+        module = types.ModuleType(module_name)
+        module.__all__ = exported
+
+        for name in names:
+            namespace = {}
+            exec(
+                f"def {name}():\n"
+                f'    """generated docstring"""\n'
+                f"    return None\n",
+                namespace,
+            )
+            func = namespace[name]
+            func.__module__ = module_name
+            setattr(module, name, func)
+
+        sys.modules[module_name] = module
+
+        from sphinx.ext.autodoc import ALL
+        from sphinx.ext.autodoc import ModuleDocumenter
+        from sphinx.ext.autodoc import Options
+
+        options = Options()
+        options["members"] = ALL
+        options["imported_members"] = False
+        options["inherited_members"] = False
+        options["undoc_members"] = False
+        options["private_members"] = None
+        options["special_members"] = []
+        options["exclude_members"] = set()
+        options["ignore_module_all"] = False
+
+        registry = types.SimpleNamespace(
+            autodoc_attrgetters={},
+            autodoc_attrgettrs={},
+        )
+        app = types.SimpleNamespace(
+            registry=registry,
+            emit_firstresult=lambda *args, **kwargs: None,
+        )
+        config = types.SimpleNamespace(
+            autodoc_mock_imports=[],
+            autodoc_warningiserror=True,
+            autodoc_inherit_docstrings=True,
+        )
+        env = types.SimpleNamespace(
+            app=app,
+            config=config,
+            temp_data={},
+            ref_context={},
+            note_reread=lambda: None,
+        )
+        directive = types.SimpleNamespace(env=env, genopt=options)
+
+        documenter = ModuleDocumenter(directive, module_name)
+        assert documenter.parse_name()
+        assert documenter.import_object()
+
+        _, members = documenter.get_object_members(True)
+        visible = documenter.filter_members(members, True)

+        visible_generated_names = visible_names.intersection(names)

+        assert visible_generated_names == set(exported)
+    finally:
+        teardown_state(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+
+    pytest.main([__file__, "--hypothesis-verbosity=verbose", "--hypothesis-log-all", "-vs"])

+    from _pytest._code.code import ExceptionInfo

+def setup_state():

+

+
+def _raise_exception_chain(messages, explicit):
+    if len(messages) == 1:
+        raise ValueError(messages[0])
+
+    try:
+        _raise_exception_chain(messages[:-1], explicit)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        if explicit:
+            raise ValueError(messages[-1]) from exc
+        raise ValueError(messages[-1])
+
+
+def _make_longrepr(messages, explicit):
+    try:
+        _raise_exception_chain(messages, explicit)
+    except Exception:
+        return ExceptionInfo.from_current().getrepr(style="long", chain=True)
+
+
+def _make_report(longrepr):
+    return TestReport(
+        nodeid="pbt::case",
+        location=("pbt_case.py", 1, "case"),

+        name = data.draw(

+
+

+
+
+def setup_state():
+    return None
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    return None
+
+
+def make_auth(username, password, challenge):
+    auth = HTTPDigestAuth(username, password)
+
+    if hasattr(auth, "init_per_thread_state"):
+        auth.init_per_thread_state()
+
+    if hasattr(auth, "_thread_local"):
+        auth._thread_local.chal = challenge
+        auth._thread_local.last_nonce = ""
+        auth._thread_local.nonce_count = 0
+    else:
+        auth.chal = challenge
+        auth.last_nonce = ""
+        auth.nonce_count = 0
+
+    return auth
+
+
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(
+    max_examples=200,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[
+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,

+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):

+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")

+        realm = data.draw(st.text(alphabet=SAFE, min_size=1, max_size=12))
+        nonce = data.draw(st.text(alphabet=SAFE, min_size=1, max_size=20))
+        method = data.draw(st.sampled_from(["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE"]))
+        path = data.draw(st.text(alphabet=SAFE, min_size=1, max_size=20))
+        url = "http://example.com/" + path
+

+            assert 'realm="%s"' % realm in header
+            assert 'nonce="%s"' % nonce in header
+            assert 'uri="/%s"' % path in header

+            assert "cnonce=" not in header

+import sys
+

+from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
+from sklearn.ensemble import VotingClassifier
+from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
+
+
+def setup_state():
+    return load_iris(return_X_y=True)
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    pass
+
+
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(
+    max_examples=200,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[
+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,
+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):
+    import os
+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        X, y = state
+        dropped_name = data.draw(st.sampled_from(["lr", "rf"]))
+        random_state = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=20))
+
+        voter = VotingClassifier(
+            estimators=[

+                    "lr",
+                    LogisticRegression(
+                        solver="liblinear",
+                        max_iter=200,
+                        random_state=random_state,

+                ),

+                        random_state=random_state,

+import sys
+from io import StringIO
+from pathlib import Path
+from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
+
+from hypothesis import HealthCheck
+from hypothesis import given
+from hypothesis import settings as hypothesis_settings
+from hypothesis import strategies as st
+from sphinx.application import Sphinx
+
+
+def setup_state():
+    tmp = TemporaryDirectory()
+    root = Path(tmp.name)
+    return {"tmp": tmp, "root": root, "apps": []}
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    for app in reversed(state.get("apps", [])):
+        try:
+            app.cleanup()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    state["tmp"].cleanup()
+
+
+def make_project(state, entries, existing_docs):
+    root = state["root"]
+
+    (root / "conf.py").write_text(
+        "\n".join(
+            [
+                "project = 'toctree-generated-pages'",
+                "master_doc = 'index'",
+                "extensions = []",
+                "exclude_patterns = []",
+                "html_theme = 'alabaster'",
+                "",
+            ]
+        ),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+    toctree_entries = "\n".join("   %s" % entry for entry in entries)
+    (root / "index.rst").write_text(
+        "Index\n"
+        "=====\n\n"
+        ".. toctree::\n"
+        "   :maxdepth: 1\n"
+        "   :caption: Indices and tables\n\n"
+        "%s\n" % toctree_entries,
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+    for docname in existing_docs:
+        title = docname.title()
+        (root / ("%s.rst" % docname)).write_text(
+            "%s\n%s\n\nExisting document.\n" % (title, "=" * len(title)),
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+
+    status = StringIO()
+    warning = StringIO()
+    app = Sphinx(
+        srcdir=str(root),
+        confdir=str(root),
+        outdir=str(root / "_build" / "html"),
+        doctreedir=str(root / "_build" / "doctrees"),
+        buildername="html",
+        freshenv=True,
+        warningiserror=False,
+        status=status,
+        warning=warning,
+    )
+    state["apps"].append(app)
+    app.build(force_all=True)
+    return warning.getvalue()
+
+
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(
+    max_examples=10,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[
+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,
+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):
+    import os
+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        if is_regression == "true":
+            entries = data.draw(
+                st.lists(
+                    st.sampled_from(["intro", "usage", "api", "faq"]),
+                    min_size=1,
+                    max_size=4,
+                    unique=True,
+                ),
+                label="existing_source_documents",
+            )
+            warnings = make_project(state, entries, existing_docs=entries)
+            assert "toctree contains reference to nonexisting document" not in warnings
+
+        elif is_regression == "false":
+            entries = data.draw(
+                st.lists(
+                    st.sampled_from(["genindex", "modindex", "search"]),
+                    min_size=1,
+                    max_size=3,
+                    unique=True,
+                ),
+                label="generated_html_pages",
+            )
+            warnings = make_project(state, entries, existing_docs=[])
+            assert "toctree contains reference to nonexisting document" not in warnings
+
+        else:
+            print("Error: IS_REGRESSION must be either 'true' or 'false'.")
+            sys.exit(1)
+    finally:
+        teardown_state(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+
+    pytest.main([__file__, "--hypothesis-verbosity=verbose", "--hypothesis-log-all", "-vs"])

+import sys

+

+
+
+def setup_state():
+    tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    return {
+        "tmp": tmp,
+        "root": Path(tmp.name),
+        "sys_path": list(sys.path),
+        "module_prefixes": [],
+    }
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    sys.path[:] = state["sys_path"]
+    prefixes = tuple(state["module_prefixes"])
+    for name in list(sys.modules):
+        if any(name == prefix or name.startswith(prefix + ".") for prefix in prefixes):
+            del sys.modules[name]
+    state["tmp"].cleanup()
+
+
+def render_output(state, files, target_module, target_class, mocked_imports):
+    srcdir = state["root"] / "src"
+    outdir = state["root"] / "out"
+    srcdir.mkdir()
+    outdir.mkdir()
+
+    state["module_prefixes"].extend(Path(name).stem for name in files)
+    state["module_prefixes"].extend(mocked_imports)
+
+    (srcdir / "conf.py").write_text(

+        "master_doc = 'index'\n"
+        "project = 'pbt-autodoc-mock-bases'\n"
+        f"autodoc_mock_imports = {mocked_imports!r}\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    (srcdir / "index.rst").write_text(
+        "API\n"
+        "===\n\n"
+        f".. autoclass:: {target_module}.{target_class}\n"
+        "   :show-inheritance:\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+    for filename, source in files.items():
+        (srcdir / filename).write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+    from sphinx.cmd.build import build_main
+
+    status = build_main(["-b", "text", "-q", "-E", str(srcdir), str(outdir)])
+    assert status == 0
+
+    return "\n".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in outdir.glob("*.txt"))

+
+@given(data=st.data())

+)
+def test(data):

+

+    try:

+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import textwrap
+
+from hypothesis import HealthCheck
+from hypothesis import given
+from hypothesis import settings as hypothesis_settings
+from hypothesis import strategies as st
+
+
+def setup_state():
+    return tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    state.cleanup()
+
+
+def make_module(directory, source):
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
+        "w",
+        prefix="check_",
+        suffix=".py",
+        dir=directory,
+        delete=False,
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    ) as handle:
+        handle.write(textwrap.dedent(source))
+        return handle.name
+
+
+def invoke_pytest(args, cwd):
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    env["PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD"] = "1"
+    env.pop("PYTEST_ADDOPTS", None)
+
+    paths = [path for path in sys.path if path]
+    if env.get("PYTHONPATH"):
+        paths.append(env["PYTHONPATH"])
+    env["PYTHONPATH"] = os.pathsep.join(paths)
+
+    return subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest"] + args,
+        cwd=cwd,
+        env=env,
+        text=True,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+    )
+
+
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(
+    max_examples=10,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[
+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,
+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)

+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")

+                min_size=1,
+                max_size=12,
+            )
+        )
+        class_name = "Tests" + suffix
+
+        if is_regression == "true":
+            path = make_module(
+                state.name,
+                f"""
+                import unittest
+
+                class {class_name}(unittest.TestCase):
+                    x = 0
+
+                    @classmethod
+                    def setUpClass(cls):
+                        cls.x += 1
+
+                    def test_one(self):
+                        assert self.x == 1
+
+                    def test_two(self):
+                        assert self.x == 1
+
+                    @classmethod
+                    def tearDownClass(cls):
+                        cls.x -= 1
+
+                def test_after_unittest_class_finished():
+                    assert {class_name}.x == 0
+                """,
+            )
+
+            result = invoke_pytest(["-q", path], state.name)
+            assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout

+
+                    def test_one(self):

+import sys

+    deadline=None,

+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,
+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):
+    import os
+    import numpy as np
+    from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
+    from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict
+    from sklearn.multioutput import MultiOutputClassifier
+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        n_samples = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=20, max_value=30))
+        n_features = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=2, max_value=5))
+        n_outputs = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=2, max_value=4))
+        cv = data.draw(st.integers(min_value=2, max_value=5))
+
+        rows = np.arange(n_samples, dtype=float)
+        X = np.column_stack(
+            [
+                np.sin((rows + 1.0) * (j + 1.0))
+                + np.cos((rows + 2.0) / (j + 2.0))
+                + ((rows % (j + 3)) / float(j + 4))
+                for j in range(n_features)
+            ]
+        )
+        Y = np.column_stack(
+            [((np.arange(n_samples) + j) % 2).astype(int) for j in range(n_outputs)]
+        )
+
+        estimator = MultiOutputClassifier(LinearDiscriminantAnalysis())
+
+        if is_regression == "true":
+            predictions = cross_val_predict(estimator, X, Y, cv=cv)
+            assert predictions.shape == Y.shape
+            assert np.isin(predictions, [0, 1]).all()
+        elif is_regression == "false":
+            probabilities = cross_val_predict(
+                estimator, X, Y, cv=cv, method="predict_proba"
+            )
+            assert isinstance(probabilities, list)
+            assert len(probabilities) == n_outputs
+            for proba in probabilities:
+                assert proba.shape == (n_samples, 2)
+                assert np.isfinite(proba).all()
+                assert np.all(proba >= -1e-12)
+                assert np.all(proba <= 1.0 + 1e-12)
+                assert np.allclose(proba.sum(axis=1), 1.0, atol=1e-7)
+        else:
+            print("Error: IS_REGRESSION must be either 'true' or 'false'.")
+            sys.exit(1)
+    finally:
+        teardown_state(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+
+    pytest.main([__file__, "--hypothesis-verbosity=verbose", "--hypothesis-log-all", "-vs"])

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from docutils import nodes

+from hypothesis import settings as hypothesis_settings
+from hypothesis import strategies as st
+
+from sphinx.addnodes import pending_xref
+from sphinx.domains.python import PyField
+
+
+def setup_state():
+    domain = SimpleNamespace(process_field_xref=lambda refnode: None)
+    config = SimpleNamespace(python_use_unqualified_type_names=False)
+    environment = SimpleNamespace(
+        ref_context={},
+        config=config,
+        get_domain=lambda name: domain,
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        field=PyField("type", names=("type",), label="Type", rolename="class"),
+        environment=environment,
+    )
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    pass
+
+
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(
+    max_examples=200,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[
+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,
+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):
+    import os
+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    mode = {"true": "regression", "false": "reproduction"}.get(is_regression)
+    if mode is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION must be either 'true' or 'false'.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        type_name = st.sampled_from(["bytes", "str", "int", "float", "bool"])
+        left, right = data.draw(
+            st.tuples(type_name, type_name).filter(lambda pair: pair[0] != pair[1])
+        )
+
+        separator = " or " if mode == "regression" else " | "
+        annotation = left + separator + right
+
+        made_nodes = state.field.make_xrefs(
+            "class", "py", annotation, nodes.literal, None, state.environment
+        )
+
+        cross_refs = [node for node in made_nodes if isinstance(node, pending_xref)]
+        rendered = "".join(node.astext() for node in made_nodes)
+        separators = "".join(
+            node.astext() for node in made_nodes if not isinstance(node, pending_xref)
+        )
+
+        assert rendered == annotation
+        assert [node.astext() for node in cross_refs] == [left, right]
+        assert [node.get("refdomain") for node in cross_refs] == ["py", "py"]
+        assert [node.get("reftype") for node in cross_refs] == ["class", "class"]
+        assert [node.get("reftarget") for node in cross_refs] == [left, right]
+        assert separator.strip() in separators
+    finally:
+        teardown_state(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest

+    pytest.main([__file__, "--hypothesis-verbosity=verbose", "--hypothesis-log-all", "-vs"])

+    attrs = dict(attrs)
+    attrs["__module__"] = __name__
+    attrs["Meta"] = type("Meta", (), {"app_label": APP_LABEL})
+    return type(name, (models.Model,), attrs)
+
+
+Author = make_model(
+    "Author",
+    {
+        "name": models.CharField(max_length=64),
+    },
+)
+
+Book = make_model(
+    "Book",
+    {

+            related_name="books",
+            on_delete=models.CASCADE,
+        ),
+    },
+)
+
+_SCHEMA_READY = False
+
+
+def ensure_schema():
+    global _SCHEMA_READY
+
+    existing = set(connection.introspection.table_names())
+    if _SCHEMA_READY and Author._meta.db_table in existing and Book._meta.db_table in existing:

+
+    with connection.schema_editor() as schema_editor:
+        existing = set(connection.introspection.table_names())
+        if Author._meta.db_table not in existing:

+        existing = set(connection.introspection.table_names())
+        if Book._meta.db_table not in existing:

+
+    _SCHEMA_READY = True
+
+

+

+                    return func(*args, **kwargs)
+

+                return inner

+from hypothesis import given
+from hypothesis import settings as hypothesis_settings
+from hypothesis import strategies as st
+
+from django.apps.registry import Apps
+
+
+def setup_state():
+    registry = Apps(installed_apps=())
+    models = []
+
+    def get_models(include_auto_created=False, include_swapped=False):
+        return list(models)
+
+    get_models.cache_clear = lambda: None
+    registry.get_models = get_models
+    return {"registry": registry, "models": models}
+
+
+def teardown_state(state):
+    state["registry"].get_swappable_settings_name.cache_clear()
+    state["models"].clear()
+
+
+def make_model(label_lower, setting_name):
+    meta = SimpleNamespace(label_lower=label_lower, swappable=setting_name, swapped=None)
+    return SimpleNamespace(_meta=meta)
+
+
+@given(data=st.data())
+@hypothesis_settings(
+    max_examples=200,
+    deadline=None,
+    suppress_health_check=[
+        HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture,
+        HealthCheck.too_slow,
+        HealthCheck.filter_too_much,
+    ],
+)
+def test(data):
+    import os
+
+    is_regression = os.environ.get("IS_REGRESSION")
+    if is_regression is None:
+        print("Error: IS_REGRESSION environment variable is not defined.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    state = setup_state()
+    try:
+        alphabet = string.ascii_letters
+        app_label = data.draw(st.text(alphabet=alphabet, min_size=1, max_size=8))
+        model_name = data.draw(st.text(alphabet=alphabet, min_size=1, max_size=8))
+        setting_name = data.draw(
+            st.text(alphabet=string.ascii_uppercase + "_", min_size=1, max_size=16)
+        )
+
+        model_label = f"{app_label}.{model_name}"
+        label_lower = model_label.lower()
+
+        if is_regression == "true":
+            state["models"].append(make_model(label_lower, setting_name))
+            result = state["registry"].get_swappable_settings_name(model_label.upper())
+            assert result == setting_name
+
+        elif is_regression == "false":
+            result_before_change = state["registry"].get_swappable_settings_name(
+                model_label
+            )
+            assert result_before_change is None
+
+            state["models"].append(make_model(label_lower, setting_name))
+            state["registry"].clear_cache()
+
+            result_after_clear = state["registry"].get_swappable_settings_name(
+                model_label
+            )
+            assert result_after_clear == setting_name
+    finally:
+        teardown_state(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+
+    pytest.main(
+        [__file__, "--hypothesis-verbosity=verbose", "--hypothesis-log-all", "-vs"]
+    )
